label: INFORMATION_ACQUISITION_3: An actual change in a system produced by input from an object or signal
term: information acquisition (a modern alternative reading of reception)
definition: An actual change in a system produced by input from an object or signal. This is a possible modern reading of reception, distinct from a capacity to have the form of another thing and distinct from divine causal knowing. No such change is asserted by CanHaveForm.
note: A comparison sense only, retained to prevent substituting a modern input-event model for the aptitudinal source wording. No thesis that intellect is or is not information processing is proved. The separately encoded DEF-Q14-FOREIGN-FORM-CHANGE-PROXY checks an occurring foreign-form state change only; actual input causation and full information acquisition are NOT encoded by that proxy. Its calibration failure does not refute this broader reading.
